verdict.rationale: Wrangler and its command-driven config (bindings, cron, queues, KV/D1/R2 declarations) let a devops-lead declare much of a Worker's architecture and deploy/rollback versions via CLI, but evidence doesn't confirm a single unified config file spans the 'entire architecture' (multiple services, multi-worker setups) and community notes highlight lock-in/DX friction around this model.
